Yuki Tsunoda's teammates from 2021 to 2025 were Pierre Gasly, Daniel Ricciardo, Liam Lawson, Nyck de Vries, Isack Hadjar and Max Verstappen. Of these, only Max Verstappen won a drivers' championship in 2000-2025 (2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024). He was Tsunoda's teammate at Red Bull in 2025.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
